summary.text: Scott Slater is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 10 since 2009, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate and as the House deputy majority leader.

paragraphs.text: Scott Slater earned a B.S. from Bryant University, and his professional experience includes working as a budget analyst for the City of Providence.
In the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions he was first vice chair of the House Finance Committee.
He and his wife, Bianca, have two children, according to Ballotpedia.
